# Browser video fixtures

Media fixtures in this directory are deterministic browser-test inputs. `stage3-moving-square.webm.base64` is the base64 encoding of a 160×100, 10 fps, 2.0 s VP9 WebM with a 30×30 white square moving left-to-right over a black background. It is used to verify real object movement, seeking, and renderer propagation in the Stage 3 video-import baseline.
